skills.name: English Fluency
skills.description: Speak and write clear, natural, correct English at work.

lessons.title: Sentence Backbone and Articles
lessons.focus: Subject-verb-object order, a/an/the, common preposition errors, singular/plural agreement, fixing frequent workplace errors such as 'revert back' and 'discuss about'.

lessons.title: Tenses in Real Use
lessons.focus: Present perfect vs past simple, present continuous for plans, reporting what people said, time expressions, choosing a tense by meaning not by rule-memorising.

lessons.title: Precise Vocabulary and Collocations
lessons.focus: Word families, collocations (make a decision, not do a decision), replacing vague words (good, thing, nice), workplace phrasal verbs, a vocabulary notebook that actually sticks.

lessons.title: Speaking With Fluency
lessons.focus: Chunking, pausing instead of filler words, pace, structured spoken answers (point-reason-example-point), shadowing, a 5-minute daily self-recording routine.

skills.name: Reading Habits
skills.description: Read consistently, understand deeply and retain what matters.

lessons.title: Building a Daily Reading Habit
lessons.focus: Cue-routine-reward for reading, minimum viable pages, environment, reading log, choosing the first book list.

lessons.title: Active Reading
lessons.focus: Purpose before reading, previewing, SQ3R, questions while reading, annotating, reading vs skimming vs scanning.

lessons.title: Reading Non-Fiction and Technical Text
lessons.focus: Reading structure (abstract, headings, conclusion first), summarising in your own words, slowing down for dense material, reading documentation and long articles.

lessons.title: Retention and Turning Reading into Action
lessons.focus: Cornell notes, recall practice, spaced review of notes, linking ideas, book-to-action page, building and pruning a reading list.

skills.name: Writing Skills
skills.description: Write clearly, persuasively and professionally.

lessons.title: Clear Writing
lessons.focus: Audience and purpose, plain language, short sentences, active voice, cutting filler, one idea per paragraph.

lessons.title: Professional Emails and Messages
lessons.focus: Subject lines, bottom-line-up-front, one clear ask, tone, follow-up, chat messages vs emails.

lessons.title: Structure and Persuasion
lessons.focus: Outlines, PEEL paragraphs, reports and one-page briefs, using evidence and examples, logical flow.

lessons.title: Editing and Revision
lessons.focus: Multiple edit passes (structure, sentence, word, proofread), reading aloud, checklists, receiving and applying feedback.

skills.name: Presentation Skills
skills.description: Structure and deliver talks that land.

lessons.title: Structuring a Talk
lessons.focus: One core message, audience analysis, three-part structure, strong opening and close, time budgeting.

lessons.title: Slides and Visuals
lessons.focus: One idea per slide, headline-as-message, simple charts, avoiding text walls, speaker notes.

lessons.title: Delivery, Nerves and Q&A
lessons.focus: Voice, pace, pauses, eye contact, rehearsal method, managing nerves, handling questions including hard ones.

skills.name: Critical Thinking
skills.description: Evaluate claims, arguments and evidence soundly.

lessons.title: Claims, Arguments and Evidence
lessons.focus: Premises vs conclusions, types of evidence, strong vs weak arguments, spotting hidden assumptions.

lessons.title: Fallacies and Cognitive Biases
lessons.focus: Ad hominem, straw man, false dilemma, slippery slope, appeal to authority/popularity, confirmation bias, anchoring, sunk cost, availability.

lessons.title: Numbers, Statistics and Causation
lessons.focus: Correlation vs causation, base rates, sample size, averages vs medians, percentages vs percentage points, misleading charts.

lessons.title: Reasoning Under Uncertainty
lessons.focus: Steelmanning, calibrated confidence, pre-mortem, second-order thinking, changing your mind with evidence.

skills.name: Problem-Solving
skills.description: Define, break down and solve problems systematically.

lessons.title: Define the Real Problem
lessons.focus: Problem statements, symptoms vs root causes, 5 Whys, fishbone diagram, scoping and constraints.

lessons.title: Decompose and Hypothesise
lessons.focus: Issue trees, MECE, hypothesis-driven approach, prioritising branches, divide-and-conquer.

lessons.title: Options and Decisions
lessons.focus: Generating options, weighted decision matrix, trade-offs, reversible vs irreversible decisions, satisficing.

lessons.title: Execute, Test and Learn
lessons.focus: Small experiments, estimation (Fermi), debugging mindset, retrospectives, writing down what you learned.

skills.name: Research and Fact-Checking
skills.description: Find reliable information and verify claims.

lessons.title: Framing Questions and Search Strategy
lessons.focus: Turning a vague topic into answerable questions, keywords and synonyms, primary vs secondary sources, search operators as concepts, search logs.

lessons.title: Evaluating Sources
lessons.focus: Authority, evidence, incentives, recency, lateral reading, spotting low-quality or sponsored content.

lessons.title: Fact-Checking Claims
lessons.focus: Tracing a claim to its origin, checking numbers, quotes and images, two independent sources, common misinformation tactics.

lessons.title: Synthesis and Research Briefs
lessons.focus: Comparing sources, stating confidence levels, summarising evidence, attributing sources, writing a one-page research brief.

skills.name: AI and Digital Literacy
skills.description: Understand, use and question digital tools and AI responsibly.

lessons.title: How Modern AI Works (and Fails)
lessons.focus: Machine learning vs rules, language models as next-word predictors, training data, hallucination, bias, what AI is good and bad at.

lessons.title: Using AI Tools Responsibly
lessons.focus: Writing clear task specs and context, iterating, verifying outputs, privacy of what you paste, academic and professional integrity, when not to use AI. Conceptual and tool-agnostic.

lessons.title: Digital Safety and Privacy
lessons.focus: Strong passwords and managers, two-factor authentication, phishing and UPI/OTP scams, privacy settings, backups, digital footprint.

lessons.title: Digital Productivity and Data Literacy
lessons.focus: File and folder systems, spreadsheet thinking, automation thinking, evaluating tools, deepfakes and synthetic media, data ethics.

skills.name: Technical Skills
skills.description: Core engineering habits for a software and SAP ABAP career.

lessons.title: A Method for Debugging
lessons.focus: Reproduce, isolate, hypothesise, test, fix, verify; reading error messages; rubber-duck debugging; binary search on code.

lessons.title: Relational Data and SQL Thinking
lessons.focus: Tables, keys, SELECT/WHERE/JOIN/GROUP BY with a SAP-flavoured example (customer KNA1, sales order header VBAK and items VBAP), reading result sets, avoiding SELECT * and selecting in loops.

lessons.title: Version Control and Collaboration
lessons.focus: Git mental model: commit, branch, merge, pull request; good commit messages; resolving simple conflicts; safe undo.

lessons.title: Clean Code, Testing and Review
lessons.focus: Naming, small functions, comments that explain why, unit tests and edge cases, giving and receiving code review, how ABAP development moves through transport requests and test systems at a conceptual level.

skills.name: Creativity
skills.description: Generate and develop original ideas on demand.

lessons.title: Generating Ideas
lessons.focus: Divergent vs convergent thinking, quantity first, SCAMPER, using constraints, idea quotas.

lessons.title: Reframing and Connecting
lessons.focus: How Might We questions, analogies, random-input technique, inversion, combining unrelated ideas.

lessons.title: Developing and Testing Ideas
lessons.focus: Selecting ideas, quick prototypes, feedback loops, killing weak ideas, finishing creative work.

lessons.title: A Creative Practice
lessons.focus: Capture system, incubation, creative routines, beating blocks, building a small portfolio project.

skills.name: Emotional Intelligence
skills.description: Understand and manage emotions in yourself and others.

lessons.title: Self-Awareness
lessons.focus: Naming emotions precisely, triggers, body signals, values, the emotion log.

lessons.title: Self-Regulation
lessons.focus: The pause, STOP technique, reappraisal, responding vs reacting, recovering after a misstep.

lessons.title: Empathy and Active Listening
lessons.focus: Levels of listening, reflecting and paraphrasing, validating, open questions, not fixing too early.

lessons.title: Social Awareness and Relationships
lessons.focus: Reading group dynamics, giving and receiving feedback, trust, boundaries, repairing relationships.

skills.name: Stress Management
skills.description: Handle pressure and sustain your energy.

lessons.title: Understanding Stress
lessons.focus: Stress response, stressors vs stress, early warning signs, baseline stress check, good stress vs harmful stress. General wellbeing only, no diagnosis.

lessons.title: Calming the Body
lessons.focus: Slow breathing, extended exhale, box breathing, progressive muscle relaxation, short movement breaks, sleep basics.

lessons.title: Calming the Mind
lessons.focus: Cognitive reframing, circle of control, worry time, journaling, accepting uncertainty.

lessons.title: Sustainable Load
lessons.focus: Boundaries, recovery rituals, burnout warning signs, building a personal stress plan, when and how to seek professional help.

skills.name: Self-Discipline
skills.description: Do what matters when you do not feel like it.

lessons.title: Habits and Identity
lessons.focus: Cue-routine-reward, tiny habits, implementation intentions, identity-based habits.

lessons.title: Designing Your Environment
lessons.focus: Friction, commitment devices, temptation bundling, urge surfing, phone boundaries.

lessons.title: Systems Beat Motivation
lessons.focus: Energy and motivation cycles, never miss twice, streaks and lapses, minimum versions.

lessons.title: Focus and Deep Work
lessons.focus: Attention residue, focus blocks, distraction logging, deliberate practice, shutdown rituals.

skills.name: Time Management
skills.description: Spend limited time on what matters most.

lessons.title: Time Audit and Priorities
lessons.focus: Tracking time, Eisenhower matrix, important vs urgent, energy levels.

lessons.title: Planning Your Day and Week
lessons.focus: Time blocking, most important tasks, estimation and the planning fallacy, buffers.

lessons.title: Executing and Protecting Focus
lessons.focus: Pomodoro, batching, saying no, handling interruptions, meetings.

lessons.title: Weekly Review and Systems
lessons.focus: Capturing tasks, weekly review, procrastination types and fixes, deadlines and buffers.

skills.name: Goal Setting and Execution
skills.description: Turn intentions into finished results.

lessons.title: Goals That Work
lessons.focus: Outcome vs process goals, SMART, why goals fail, writing a goal precisely.

lessons.title: Breaking Goals Down
lessons.focus: Backward planning, milestones, leading vs lagging indicators, OKR-style key results.

lessons.title: Tracking, Feedback and Obstacles
lessons.focus: Weekly scorecards, if-then plans, WOOP, adjusting a plan without quitting.

lessons.title: Finishing Under Real Conditions
lessons.focus: Limiting work in progress, handling setbacks, scope cutting, a 90-day plan.

skills.name: Career Planning and Personal Branding
skills.description: Plan a career in SAP/IT services and present yourself well.

lessons.title: Career Clarity
lessons.focus: Strengths, values, interests, how IT services and consulting firms are structured, technical vs functional roles, the SAP ecosystem and the ABAP developer path, how fresher hiring works.

lessons.title: Resume and Portfolio
lessons.focus: Action-impact bullets, one-page structure, ATS basics, projects as proof, a simple portfolio.

lessons.title: Personal Brand and Online Presence
lessons.focus: Headline, summary, consistent profile, sharing work, authenticity, networking profile hygiene.

lessons.title: Interviews and Job Search Strategy
lessons.focus: STAR stories, technical interview preparation, tracking applications, offers, a 12-month career plan.

skills.name: Confidence
skills.description: Build evidence-based confidence and act despite fear.

lessons.title: What Confidence Really Is
lessons.focus: Competence-confidence loop, evidence log, self-talk, imposter feelings.

lessons.title: Body Language and Voice
lessons.focus: Posture, eye contact, voice, preparation as a confidence source.

lessons.title: Acting Despite Fear
lessons.focus: Exposure ladder, small wins, handling mistakes in public, comfort zone expansion.

lessons.title: Assertive Communication
lessons.focus: Passive vs aggressive vs assertive, I-statements, saying no, asking for what you need, receiving criticism.

skills.name: Leadership
skills.description: Lead people and projects, with or without a title.

lessons.title: What Leaders Actually Do
lessons.focus: Leadership vs management, influence without authority, ownership, setting direction.

lessons.title: Delegation and Motivation
lessons.focus: Clear expectations, delegation levels, autonomy, motivation drivers.

lessons.title: Feedback and Coaching
lessons.focus: SBI feedback, coaching questions (GROW), one-to-ones.

lessons.title: Leading Teams Through Change
lessons.focus: Team stages, running effective meetings, decision-making in teams, leading in uncertainty, student project examples.

skills.name: Negotiation
skills.description: Reach better agreements without damaging relationships.

lessons.title: Interests, Positions and Preparation
lessons.focus: Interests vs positions, BATNA, reservation point, ZOPA, preparation sheet.

lessons.title: Tactics and Conversation
lessons.focus: Anchoring, concessions, questions, silence, framing, objections.

lessons.title: Offers and Salary Negotiation
lessons.focus: Indian job offer anatomy: CTC vs in-hand, fixed vs variable, joining bonus, notice period, how freshers can negotiate respectfully; research and timing.

lessons.title: Everyday and Difficult Negotiations
lessons.focus: Handling pressure tactics, ethics, closing and following up, practice role-plays.

skills.name: Conflict Resolution
skills.description: Resolve disagreements constructively.

lessons.title: Understanding Conflict
lessons.focus: Task vs relationship conflict, escalation ladder, five conflict styles.

lessons.title: Difficult Conversations
lessons.focus: Opening scripts, I-statements, timing, listening before responding, staying on facts.

lessons.title: Resolving and Repairing
lessons.focus: Interests, options, agreements, apology and repair, using a neutral third party.

lessons.title: Conflict in Teams and Remote Work
lessons.focus: Written conflict, feedback disputes, prevention, working agreements, escalation paths.

skills.name: Networking
skills.description: Build genuine professional relationships.

lessons.title: Networking Foundations
lessons.focus: Giving first, weak ties, goals, where to find people (college, alumni, communities, online).

lessons.title: Conversations and Introductions
lessons.focus: Self-introduction, small talk, open questions, remembering names, events.

lessons.title: Outreach and Follow-Up
lessons.focus: Cold messages, informational chats, referral requests, follow-up timing, a simple contact tracker.

lessons.title: Sustaining Relationships
lessons.focus: Giving value, staying in touch, mentors, communities, networking ethics.

skills.name: Financial Literacy
skills.description: Manage money wisely (India-focused, principles over rules that change).

lessons.title: Income, Spending and Budgeting
lessons.focus: Tracking cash flow, needs/wants/savings split, emergency fund, UPI and card spend, pay yourself first.

lessons.title: Interest, Inflation and Compounding
lessons.focus: Simple vs compound interest, rule of 72, inflation and real returns, time value of money with worked rupee calculations.

lessons.title: Investing Basics and Risk
lessons.focus: Savings accounts, fixed deposits, PPF/EPF, mutual funds and SIPs, index funds, gold, diversification, risk vs return, spotting scams. Educational, not advice; rules and rates change.

lessons.title: Credit, Debt, Insurance and Taxes
lessons.focus: Credit score, credit card interest traps, EMIs, term and health insurance basics, income tax concepts without quoting slabs, fraud safety.

skills.name: General Knowledge
skills.description: Build a durable base of world and India knowledge.

lessons.title: Indian Polity and Institutions
lessons.focus: Constitution, fundamental rights, Parliament, executive, judiciary, federalism, election basics. Stable facts only.

lessons.title: Geography and Economy Basics
lessons.focus: India and world geography essentials, GDP, inflation, budget, RBI, GST at concept level. Stable facts only, no current statistics.

lessons.title: History, Science and Environment
lessons.focus: Key world and Indian history turning points, how scientific method and basic physics/biology facts show up in daily life, climate and environment basics.

lessons.title: Following the World and Remembering It
lessons.focus: International organisations (UN, WTO, IMF), a news-reading routine, building a knowledge notebook, mnemonics and memory palace, verifying claims.

skills.name: Adaptability
skills.description: Thrive when plans, tools and people change.

lessons.title: Mindset for Change
lessons.focus: Growth mindset, the change curve, tolerance of uncertainty.

lessons.title: Learning Agility
lessons.focus: Learning a new tool fast, Feynman technique, deliberate practice, learning plans.

lessons.title: Resilience After Setbacks
lessons.focus: Reframing failure, post-mortems, plan B, bouncing back.

lessons.title: Navigating New Environments
lessons.focus: First 90 days, shifting requirements in client projects, culture fit, flexibility without losing principles.

skills.name: Professional Etiquette
skills.description: Behave with polish in workplaces and formal settings.

lessons.title: First Impressions and Workplace Basics
lessons.focus: Punctuality, greetings, handshakes, introductions, remembering names, appropriate behaviour.

lessons.title: Email, Chat and Meeting Etiquette
lessons.focus: Teams/Slack norms, CC/BCC, reply-all, response times, video-call etiquette.

lessons.title: Meals, Events and Cross-Cultural Awareness
lessons.focus: Business meals, corporate events, hierarchy, cross-cultural differences, gifts.

lessons.title: Professional Ethics and Conduct
lessons.focus: Confidentiality, honesty, owning mistakes, social media conduct, respect, harassment awareness, managing up.

skills.name: Personal Grooming
skills.description: Look and feel prepared for professional settings.

lessons.title: Grooming Foundations
lessons.focus: Hygiene, skin, hair and dental basics, clean and well-fitting clothes, a simple daily routine. Inclusive and neutral.

lessons.title: Dressing for Context
lessons.focus: Interview, office, client site, virtual calls; fit, colour basics, shoes, ironing, a budget wardrobe.

lessons.title: Presence and Self-Care
lessons.focus: Posture, sleep, fitness basics, a pre-interview checklist, sustainable routines.
